truth.situation: I'm the analyst at a gym chain with 14 clubs; our customers table has one row per member, with churned_next_month.
truth.goal: I want each club manager to get, every week, the members most likely to cancel next month so they can talk to them in time.
truth.decision: Every week each club manager picks about 20 members to offer a free personal-training session to keep them.
truth.user: 14 club managers, about 20 conversations each per week
truth.data: The customers table I uploaded: customer_id, signup_date, segment, city, plan, tenure_months, monthly_spend, support_tickets_90d, churned_next_month.
truth.knows: I'm good at SQL and reports; I've never built a predictive model and assumed this is just a filtered report.
truth.constraints: It must refresh weekly, managers only read a simple list, and I want a first version within two weeks.

must_understand: 'likely to cancel next month' needs a forward-looking score per member, not a report of past cancellations
each club manager acts on about 20 members a week
the list must refresh weekly and stay simple for managers

transcript.text: need a weekly report of members likely to cancel next month. can you set that up [shares customers.csv]

transcript.text:
I'll start by looking at the columns in your table.

I've started a prediction project. Your table has a `churned_next_month` column with 1,200 customers, so DCLab can learn from it which members tend to cancel. It will use columns like plan, tenure, monthly spend, segment and recent support tickets.

A weekly report needs a model that scores members first, so the model comes first. Once it's built, we can set up the weekly report listing the members most likely to cancel.

I haven't set up the weekly schedule yet. I'll do that after we've checked how well the model predicts.
transcript.text_fa:
اول ستون‌های جدولتان را نگاه می‌کنم.

یک پروژه پیش‌بینی را شروع کرده‌ام. جدول شما یک ستون `churned_next_month` با 1,200 مشتری دارد، پس DCLab می‌تواند از آن یاد بگیرد که چه اعضایی معمولاً لغو می‌کنند. از ستون‌هایی مثل plan، مدت عضویت (tenure)، هزینه ماهانه، segment و تیکت‌های پشتیبانی اخیر استفاده می‌کند.

یک گزارش هفتگی اول به مدلی نیاز دارد که به اعضا امتیاز بدهد، پس مدل اول می‌آید. وقتی ساخته شد، می‌توانیم گزارش هفتگی را راه بیندازیم که اعضایی را که بیشترین احتمال لغو را دارند فهرست کند.

هنوز زمان‌بندی هفتگی را راه نینداخته‌ام. این کار را بعد از اینکه بررسی کردیم مدل چقدر خوب پیش‌بینی می‌کند انجام می‌دهم.
